balls.text: Full outside off again, driven on the bounce to long-off and RCB finish on 175 for 8
Full outside off, drilled wide of long-off for a single. But wait a bit of lazy fielding from long-off allows a second run
Jitesh picks out long-off! This is a full toss outside off, pace on this time. Jitesh looks to go downtown but finds the fielder. A laboured knock from Jitesh comes to an end
Jitesh is outfoxed by this length ball outside off and ends up gloving it onto his pads. Ngidi appealed for leg before. Good thing they didn't review that!

Mix-up and there's a run-out! Banged in short and going down leg. Krunal looked to hook but couldn't connect. Jitesh Sharma runs down the ground before Krunal can even turn and look and he's in no man's land when Rahul throws this to Ngidi, to take the bails off. Krunal is miffed with that
Another yorker outside off, Jitesh can only squeeze it out to long-off
In the blockhole outside off, jammed out to long-off

Yorker outside off, angled across. Jitesh jams his bat down and there's a sound as ball goes past the bat. Rahul thinks it's an edge and convinces Axar to review. UltraEdge shows the sound was from the bat hitting ground. However, that was a superb delivery and another dot ball
Yorker outside off, Krunal gets an inside edge through square leg and they get a single. Just the second run in the over!
Short outside off, 123kph, Krunal looks to pull and misses
Natarajan nails the wide yorker. Krunal reaches out for it but can't conenct
Krunal looks to get inside the line of this 125kph length ball around off and help it over the keeper, but can't connect
Full toss on off, driven down to long-off

Krunal Pandya you beauty! Gets the crowd on its feet again as he takes on Ngidi this time, launching him straight down the ground and that flies over the sight screen. Even Ngidi can't help but admire that. The slower ball was taken down this time
Short ball outside off, 109.5kph, pulled out to deep midwicket
Looks for the slower yorker on middle, Krunal works it down to long-on
Full around off, Jitesh eases it down to long-on

Beats short third and it dribbles away! Mukesh misjudged that! Jitesh skips down the track as Ngidi bowls a wide back-of-length off cutter and slashes at it. The ball goes up off the toe end and fine on the off side. Mukesh runs to his left and throws himself at it, but can't grab it. Now Mukesh is going off the field for treatment as he may have landed a bit heavy. Seems to have injured his face there
It's that dipping pace-off yorker on off. Krunal whips it off his toes through square leg
On a length outside off, punched out to deep cover
Kuldeep goes for a legbreak on a length but it's quite wide and spins away even more. Called wide
Full on the stumps, Jitesh backs away and drives it to deep cover on the bounce
Legbreak on a length spinning away, Krunal waits on it and dabs it late, fine on the off side. Short third chases

Has Kuldeep yorked Romario Shepherd? This is tossed up around leg and Romario has an odd swipe across the line and misses. Finger goes up immediately. Romario's reviewed this. UltraEdge confirms there was no bat on it. And that's about as plumb as it gets, pitching on middle and crashing into middle and off. Poor shot from Romario, and a poor review
Googly on a length on leg, Jitesh hangs back and works it to deep midwicket
On a length around off, punched to short cover
On a length around off, blocked back to the bowler
On a length outside off, pulled to deep midwicket
On a length outside off, punched through cover
Full around off, driven to short cover
Looks to go big but gets a top edge to short third! David wanted to take Axar on this over, and he gets out trying to do that. This is not quite full enough for the slog and leads to David's downfall
David turns down the single after swinging a length ball out to deep midwicket!
Very full outside off, driven to cover. That's a dot
Yorker outside off, squeezed out to deep cover

Banged in short, skies it to the keeper, buuuuut it's a free hit so it's just a single. Good stuff from Mukesh with a slower short ball that Jitesh tries to pull. Gets a top edge that goes high and behind to Rahul

Short outside off, pulled to deep midwicket. Just a single. Hold on, it's been reviewed for a third ball in the over above the shoulder, which would make it a no-ball. And the review works. It's a no-ball. And we'll have a free hit!
Bouncer outside off, and it's too short. His third wide of this nature
Lovely yorker outside off. David looks to jam his bat down with an open face, but the ball evades contact
Backs away to this short ball and looks to flat bat it down the ground. Doesn't quite hit it very well, but it goes on the bounce to long-off
Bouncer outside off, 137.7kph. David swats it out to deep midwicket, while keeping it grounded
Length ball outside off, punched away to deep cover
Clips this length ball to deep midwicket and Jitesh is off the mark
Full around mdidle and off, blocked towards the bowler
Arm ball on a length around off, Jitesh digs it out to cover
Better length, better line closer to off. David punches it down to long-off
That's not going to stop the run flow! Half-tracker, wide of off. David has long levers and has no trouble in slapping this away through cover
On a length outside off, Jitesh looks to drive, but is beaten. Good stuff from Mukesh Kumar
Banged in short on off and going across. Called wide
Jitesh is greeted with a yorker on the stumps. Jams his bat down to keep it out

Edged and taken! That was anti-climactic! Massive moment for Delhi Capitals This is a half-volley but quite wide. Patidar goes chasing with a drive and gets a thin edge off the toe end of the bat. Rahul takes a neat catch to his right. Patidar's first single-digit score of the season
Bumps it short, and it's angled across. Patidar stays still and watches it go over him for a wide

And there goes Patidar! The RCB captain has been in electric form this season, and it wasn't long till we saw him put one away today. This is bashed off a good length outside off, and it goes flying over cow corner
Short ball doesn't quite rise enough for the pull. David just helps it towards short fine leg and they take a risky single
Length ball on off, 139kph, clipped to deep midwicket

Beats the fielder! Rasping drive to the cover fielder's right, beating his dive. Looks for the wide yorker but ends up with a slot ball outside off at 133kph. David has enough room to crunch this in the gap
Ngidi looks for the yorker, still pace on. Not quite full enough, but still in the blockhole. Patidar works this down to long-on's left
Yorker around middle, David manages to get his bat down and squeeze this down to long-on
Tucked in front on the leg side
Hold that! This is overpitched and sits up nicely. David hits it oh so hard and straight down the ground to the right of the sight screen
Full outside off, 136kph, punched uppishly to cover
On a length around middle, punched down to long-off
David cuts it away for four to start. That's the thing with RCB, the intent this year. This is on a length outside off and David waits on it and plays it late to find the gap

Kuldeep has his revenge! It's short-ish but also wide and angled across him. Salt has to reach away from his body as he tries to flat-bat it down the ground. Doesn't get the elevation or distance and it's an easy catch for Tristan Stubbs. Two wickets in two overs, and DC may have pulled things back here
Length ball angled across, Salt misses again
Oooh, good comeback. Pitched up, drawing Salt into a drive over mid-off, but this spins away to beat the outside edge
Ohh that's massive! That's a long hop and Salt has a strong base and swings it high over deep midwicket
Left-armer gets left-hander! With a slot ball too, no less. 96ks, around off stump. Padikkal's eyes light up and he drives through the line but ends up scraping it to long-on.
Length on leg, clipped through midwicket
Length on off, slides the front leg out of the way and works it to long-on

Deceives the batter and beats the keeper too! There was an edge in face, the ball took off as though it was big bounce off the pitch. Rahul had no time to get his hands to the left. Padikkal danced down to the wide fullish ball and looked to slap it over cover
Makes room and pulls it hard. The length ball on leg goes wide of long-on
Clips it off a length to the leg side
Beaten on the cut. Not short at all, Padikkal went after it more on line than length. 86ks ball beats him for pace
Touch quicker. Length ball on middle and leg, Salt goes back and flicks through square leg
Length down leg, Padikkal looks to glance it. And he got some bat on it, ball deflected off the pad to short fine leg
Goes back and chops it from the stumps to long-off

Six right off the bat. Salt blazes to a fifty on a tough track. Walks down and across to flay a length ball canting away wide of off and drives with an open-faced vertical bat to get it over wide long-off
Kuldeep chases to midwicket but can't stop two. Was looking tight for a bit as Salt went back in the crease for the gentle flick to the edge of the ring, but Kuldeep didn't pick up the ball cleanly
Pitched up on off, driven to long-on
Padikkal sees it pitched up and swings through the line. Goes off the bottom of the bat, lands in the outfield and plugs. Long-off runs in and stops it
Short and wide, tennis-ball bounce takes it well above head. Let go
Wide not given, Padikkal checks and doesn't get it. He went across to leg stump and looked to glance the yorker coming into him. It went just past the leg stump
Fifth ball six for Padikkal! He waited against the spinner but walks down against the pacer to mess with his length. Gets it on the half-volley and drives high over long-on
Back of length just outside off, pulled into the pitch and then over the bowler to long-on
Cut off a length, might even have been a touch fuller. Salt lunged right down, got his weight down on the back leg and cut it late to thread it behind point
Wide on a length, cut to deep point
Punched down to long-off. Length ball on middle and off at 87ks, Padikkal going right back again
86ks length ball outside off, cut to deep cover
Padikkal dances down... and is stopped in his tracks by the length ball just outside off. Padikkal shaped to swing leg side, but tapped it off the back foot towards backward point
Length just outside off, same pace, punched to long-off
Fuller side of length on off, good bounce, Padikkal goes back and flicks to deep midwicket. 84ks
Wide of the crease release. Length ball just outside off, cut to deep-backward point's left. Sliding stop keeps it to two

Midwicket dives to the right... and gets beaten! He was close, ball nearly touched his right fingertips but was a touch too far away. Back of length around off, Salt a touch too early into the pull. Gets two for his troubles
Salt beaten on his bread-and-butter shot. Cross-seamer at 135ks rises off the seam and beats the full-fledged cut. Went just over the bat
Length on leg, 132ks. Slanting in and cramping Salt but he defends with an open face and gets it to the right of short third, who half-stops it
Length just outside off, square driven to deep point

Deep point takes it, Ngidi strikes first ball!. Kohli charges at the 132ks scrambled-seam ball outside off. Was on a length and seemed to slow down off the pitch. Kohli was definitely a touch too early into the shot. Looked to caress and launch it at the same time. Didn't follow through fully, bat face opened and it went too high. Nissanka moves right and takes it
Smacked straight of mid-off to bring up RCB's fifty. 133ks low full toss. Missed yorker. Finishes around shin-height. Salt arched back and thumped a drive with buckled elbows

Great fielding by Axar but there'll be overthrows. He ran left from mid-off and stopped it on the bounce with one hand. Threw it at the striker's, direct hit deflected square. Keeper and short fine were... fine. Was a length ball outside off that was cut
Slot ball. Long-on there or not, doesn't matter. Salt swings through the line with a straightish bat and a follow-through ending at the back
Length around off, punched with a straight bat to mid-on's left
Beautiful yorker. 135ks on leg stump, hits the base of the bat as Salt punches to mid-on
Yeah, can't get away three times. Slightly outside off, on a back of length. Salt clears the front leg and lifts a cut over point
Another wide one that's a dot. Fullish length ball close to the tramline, Kohli walks into the slap. Toes it to point
Mukesh gets away with it. Ring field on the off-side and the ball's outside off on a back of a length. Kohli square drives it more than cutting it. No follow-through. Finds cover point
And that's why Kohli charges and flashes over point. Showed all three stumps, got a 139ks fullish ball on middle and off. Got out the crease and carved it with an open face
Nearly a yorker with a bit of room. Cross-seamer was going low, Salt bent late and toed a drive to mid-off for a quick single
Chopped to backward point, fielder swoops in quickly. Length ball just outside off

High on the bat... and just short of the fielder!. Ngidi ran to the right from mid-on, went down for the slide a bit too early and half-stopped it on the bounce. Back of length ball at the body, Salt went for the pull
Great ball. Yorker on middle and off, Salt stays beside it and smothers it to mid-off
Bouncer outside off at 131ks, rises just under shoulder-height. Pulled off the bottom-half towards square leg
Salt looks to help it fine with a wristy whip, the length ball beats him and goes off the pad towards square leg
Pitched right up, Salt can't get fully underneath it. Jams it to mid-off
Two, for a second it looked like four. Slower ball and Salt jabbed with a cross bat, without a follow-through. Ball rolled through backward point, lost pace in the outfield
Inside edge off the flowing cover drive goes to square leg. Nabi's pace is up - 135ks, on a length just outside off
Salt has to check his shot. Looked like that rushed off the pitch. Length ball just outside off, Salt shaped to cut, ended up bunting to point
Tap and run towards point. Good bounce on the back of length ball just outside off, rose around rib-height
Defensive bowling now. Very wide length ball, Kohli reaches out with his torso and looks to cut, beaten
Swinging or not, Kohli's coming down. Lifts the back leg and lofts an extra-cover drive on the rise. Ridiculous how early he's found his timing
Length in the channel, 136ks, slapped to deep-backward point
Bottom hand comes off as Salt looks to scythe it away through point. Misses. 136ks full ball swinging away outside off
Pitched up just outside off at 135ks, Kohli looks to punch straight. Gets a thick outside edge to deep point
Length just outside off, punches towards point with a vertical bat

Good ball, finds the edge but goes wide of slip. Shades of what Anderson used to do to Kohli. Pitching it up and swinging it away towards fourth stump. Kohli looks to punch through cover, no hard hands and the shot is checked. So the ball goes along the ground
Length in the channel, square driven again. Finds the sweeper
Swing away and swung away. Salt stands upright, gets his front leg slightly across and square drives the length ball through backward point. No chance for the sweeper
Back of length on middle and leg, flicked through backward square leg. 127ks
Good bounce but down leg. Length ball landed on leg and went past the leg glance
131ks fullish ball outside off, driven on the up to deep cover

And Delhi Capitals win it with a ball to spare! David Miller, who was distraught after costing his team in a similarly tense chase not too long ago, has played a blinder here under extreme pressure to deliver for his team. Miller has built his reputation as a finisher, and today, he showed why.
David Miller levels the scores! What a shot! David Miller gets a slot ball outside off and he creams this over cover!
Miller hits this high over deep midwicket! Oh boy, Shepherd errs and bowls a juicy full toss and Miller duly obliges!
Very full on the stumps, Stubbs chips it away, but on the bounce to deep midwicket
Swing and a miss first up! On a length outside leg, and Miller was too early into the shot and misses out completely
In the blockhole outside off, driven to long-off. And DC need 15 off the final over! Good comeback from Rasikh Salam
Full around off, chipped to long-on on the bounce
Rasikh nails the blockhole delivery again. Squeezed through midwicket and this time they have enough time to run two
Very full outside off, driven wide of long-off, but not wide enough to get a second
Punched off a good length to long-off. They get just a single
Oh, that releases the pressure! Goes for the yorker, but it's sliding down the leg side and it's a low full toss. Stubbs gets enough bat on it to get it wide of short fine leg
Driven down to long-off and this over goes for 12 runs. But Bhuvneshwar has been absolutely brilliant in this game
Bhuvneshwar again goes for the blockhole delivery. This time it's flicked out in front of square leg. He gets two and gets to a fifty
Oh boy, did Delhi Capitals need that or what?! Stubbs shuffled across early. Bhuvneshwar goes for the slower bouncer and Stubbs nails the pull over square leg and it sails into the second tier!
Low full toss on the stumps, whipped out through square leg. Again, just a single!
Right in the blockhole! Stubbs digs it out towards long-on. RCB will take the single
Full, just outside off, driven along the ground to long-off

Oh, another yorker. 140kph on leg. Stubbs can only manage to keep it out! Just four off the over! And that means, the last three overs have yielded only 13 runs! And it's been 20 balls since DC have found a boundary
Nails the wide yorker! Stubbs flashes at it but can't connect. 140ks and just inside the line
Goes for the yorker around off, ends up as a very low full toss. Miller whips it to long-on's left. Just another single
Dug in short, miscues the pull into the midwicket region. They wanted two but Romario Shepherd races in from deep midwicket to keep it down to one
Direct hit could have spelt disaster for Miller! He kncoks this full ball to Patidar at cover, who misses the stumps at the non-striker's end. Miller was nowhere in the picture! Oh my
Oh, lovely yorker. Stubbs backs away and Hazlewood follows him with a toe-crusher at 137kph. He jams his bat down but can't connect. The ball rolls behind the batter and they manage to sneak a single
Full ball punched back past Bhuvi. Miller was turning back to his crease and it deflects off him towards mid-off. They manage the single due to the deflection
Axar shuffles across and looks to scoop it. Ends up paddling it over short fine leg, and to his right. Gets away there. But, Axar is also down with cramps again
Stubbs takes a step forward before Bhuvi delivers. It's a length ball outside off and Stubbs can only punch it down to long-off. No boundary now for 12 deliveries
On a length around leg, clipped through square leg
Beats Axar's attempted dab with a 133kph length ball angled across
Starts with a length ball outside off, punched to long-off
Very full around leg, swept along the ground to short fine leg. Just five runs off the over
Full on leg, another single taken, this time to deep midwicket
Full around leg, 109kph. punched down to long-on
Tucked through square leg
Length ball slung across Axar, who punches it out to deep cover
Full outside off, driven out to the off-side sweeper
Tossed up full outside off, driven to deep cover
On a length outside off, punched to cover
Slapped back past the bowler. DC taking a vicegrip on this game now. This is too short, and spinning away, giving Stubbs room to free his arms and thwack it right back down the ground
Googly on a length outside off, slapped away to deep cover's right. Shepherd makes the stop
Legbreak on a length on off, punched to cover
Googly angled across, cut away to deep cover where sub fielder Jacob Bethell is stationed. Phil Salt is off the field at the moment
Another slower ball, full outside off, driven wide of long-off and they get two. Big over for Delhi Capitals
Crunched down the ground! Stubbs has been quiet for a while, but here he takes on this slower ball, drilling it too straight for long-off to stop
Looks for the yorker outside off, dug out square on the off side
Short outside off, pulled to deep midwicket
Full outside off, pace off, Axar nudges this in front of square leg for a single
Full outside off, he looks to go downtown but ends up slicing this slot ball. His bottom hand came off the bat as the ball went high in the air to long-off. They get two for their troubles
Just past the keeper! Risky from Axar, jabbing late at this length ball with an open face. Goes past a diving Jitesh. But also, Rasikh has overstepped
On a length around leg, tucked square on the leg side
Cracking cut. Length ball angled across and Axar gets low and slaps it away past backward point
Length ball goes down leg. Given wide even as Jitesh Sharma goes up in appeal. RCB review it for the wide given. And replay confirms that it brushed his thighs
Full around off, 140ks, pushed down to long-on
138kph length ball outside off, tapped to midwicket
Length ball angled across. Axar shuffles a long way across and just nudges this into the square leg region. He initially shaped to play the scoop but had to make a late adjustment
Full on leg, punched back to Krunal's left. He makes a good stop and the crowd lets him know of their appreciation
On a length around middle, punched wide of long-on
Almost sliced to short third. And the misfield allows a couple of runs. Axar backs away and looks to play a late cut. just short of Suyash diving to his right. It goes through him
On a length around off, punched towards mid-on
Krunal goes for the bouncer and Axar just jabs at it, ramping it over short third. That looped up, but had enough distance

And Krunal breaks through! Rahul skips down the track to this flat and full delivery fired in at 103kph and looks to go over extra cover. Ends up slicing it a little and Virat Kohli runs to his left from long-off and takes a good catch. Massive moment in the game
Back of length on middle, clipped to deep midwicket
Decent ball, well played. On a length outside off, cover driven off the back foot against the turn. Feet slid back stylishly. Venkatesh charges to the right and stops it at the cover boundary
Suyash misses his line and Rahul uses it. The forward stride isn't there, the back leg collapses and the sweep comes out with hands not fully extended. Goes fine
Rahul showed all his stumps yesterday, gets a googly landing on a length and turning in. Punches off the back foot against the spin, through cover, to the deep to bring up fifty
Goes back in the crease to the 100ks length ball following him, whipped through midwicket
Goes back and works it off the back foot to deep square leg
Lifts it on the rise, the 101ks ball hits a touch low on the bat and skims over the bowler. Long-on cuts it off to the left
Length on top of leg, Stubbs gets leg side and punches to long-off
Dances down and carves the 90ks length ball on off, to deep cover. Ten balls, no bouncer from Krunal
Length on top of middle and leg, 86ks, slapped to long-off
92ks length ball outside off, caressed to deep point
Looks to punch it off the back foot through cover. Horizontal bat. Goes off the bottom-half to the bowler's right
Short again, pulls the 90ks ball on leg to deep square leg. Timeout
Shortish googly comes in towards fourth stump, pulled to long-on
Makes room and slaps it straight from top of middle. Not that bad a ball. Around a length and hurrying through, Rahul slid the front leg out and hit it with a cross bat

Suyash foxes Rahul and nearly concedes a boundary! Rahul danced down the track and was rushed by the 90ks length ball that skidded and rushed him. Rahul shaped to swipe across the line at first but then closed the bat face and stabbed across the line as a last resort. Ball took the pad and went to the keeper's right. Stopped on the deep-third boundary with a bit of close-in action
Trash. Way too short, legbreak landed halfway down the pitch. Even though it's 100ks, it took an age to get to top of middle. Rahul makes room to pull it wide of long-on
Touch short outside off, Rahul gets on one leg and pulls it nicely. Bisects long-on and deep midwicket
Full on leg, Stubbs is beside it at first. He then gets forward and across to defend it to cover
Good running to get back for two. Rasikh ran to the left from deep cover, tumbled and rose in one motion. Throw was good too but Stubbs hurried. Was a length ball outside off that was cut
Rahul cuts a length ball from middle stump like it's nothing. Finds deep point
No bouncers yet. Touch short outside off, carved off the back foot to long-off
Wide and fullish, smeared to deep cover
Pitched up around off, driven to long-off
Slow and full outside off, thrashed to long-on with the bat face turning in
Full at the stumps, jabbed to midwicket
Greatstop in the field. Charging to the left from deep-backward square. Tumbles and pushes the ball in before rolling over the cushion. Was a full ball that was brought in
Full around off, driven to long-off
Chomps the full ball with a hoovering motion. Gets it to mid-off
Rasikh begins with a slowie. 105ks and full down leg, flicked to deep-backward square

Aiii, Rahul playing with fire here. Makes room well before the delivery, which was a 138ks yorker on middle. Rahul reaches out and just about jams it on top of its head. Ball dribbles towards point. Eventful over, eventful start
Change in length again. Yorker on off, defended to cover

Heart in mouth for a second but it goes between short third and backward point. Short ball around off, he limboed and saw the ball right beside his eye before ramping it with the toe of the bat facing slip
Rahul's hitting Hazlewood off his length. Just a bit of room and the hard-length ball was cut through point
Fullish outside off, pushed to the off side

Rahul gives DC a pick-me-up by picking the ball up over square leg. He's not letting Hazlewood get into his overs. Waited for the fullish ball to come just in front of him, buckled his elbows and swooshed it wristily to get it square. Hazlewood impressed
Gets away with a low full toss on leg. Flicked to long leg
Fullish on middle and leg, punched to long-on
Length just outside off, punched with an open face to point
Angle too sharp. The full balll landed on leg and angled in further
Length on middle and leg, punched to mid-on's left
Shortish ball on top of off, pulled to deep-backward square

Excellent shot under the circumstances. Flays it over mid-off, who's well in. Was a fullish inswinger just outside off, Rahul drove through the line. Bat-face closed, may have gotten it straighter than he intended. Enough power though
Into a length, down leg, beats the leg glance
Touch wide and Stubbs creams it off the back foot through point, Stubbs races to the right again but has no chance

Stunning one-hander from Jitesh! RCB are turning the stadium into the colosseum. The ecstatic crowd and the fielders hound in. Was an outswinger on a length that Rizvi tried to punch through cover. Thick edge was going wide, close to where first slip would've been. But Jitesh got low, took it with his right hand. The upper-body fell in a heap, it looked like he had no time but he still got hold of it. Special

Wide on a length, Rizvi walks across and punches it through point. Opened the face late. Salt charges from deep third, covers ample ground to the right and slides on one knee. Picks up the ball and throws it to his team-mate in one motion
Walks towards the length ball and defends to cover

Salt slides on the practice pitch to take it at deep third! Heck of an effort. Was a few metres inside the ropes, got to the left early, took it low, rose and pumped his fists while looking at the crowd. Was a back of length ball outside off, Nair looked to take on Bhuvi again. The cut went off the upper-half of the bat.
Goes over him! Kohli leaps but it flies over his reaching right hand. Length ball outside off, Rahul flashes hard, the cut just about clears the infield
Length on middle, flicked to deep-backward square. 144ks
Length on off, 142ks, defended with an open face to point, who's standing in and keeps the non-striker in check
Touch wider, still on a length, driven to deep-backward point
Wide of deep-backward point. Nair places the square drive perfectly. 141ks length ball just outside off, top-of-stump height. Good ball. Just played well again
Stays back in the crease and defends it off a length towards cover point. Quick call and running to sneak a single

Statement of intent of Rahul! Inside-out drive over extra cover to a good ball. Length on off, Rahul's front leg was slightly outside leg, he stayed still and got low last second, got the bat down and then up in a flash
Pitched up on off, worked to the bowler's right
Fullish and outside off, defended towards forward point

Curves back in and hits front pad, big lbw appeal. Not given. Bhuvi keen, RCB review. Beaten on the flick, hit on the front knee-roll. Length ball landed outside off and came in to hit... the leg bail but wow it's three reds. Nissanka's head fell away, he was well outside the crease and looked to be outside the line too. But no. In front of off. Looked for the most part like it'd be umpire's call, but again, no!
Quick single towards midwicket. Rahul lunges forward and looks to punch it towards cover, thick inside edge
Outswinger on off, fuller side of length, defended to the bowler's right
Big edge but it goes wide of the short third, who was standing a touch forward and straight. Fullish outswinger outside off, Nissanka looked to drive it straight and on the up
